column1: # pgx_genes.tsv: the genes step 32 (scripts/32-pypgx.sh, the PYPGX module) calls with pypgx,
# one row per gene, in the order they run. Adding a gene is adding a row.
# mode: bam = copy number from read depth plus the VCF (prepare-depth-of-coverage, then
#   run-ngs-pipeline --depth-of-coverage --variants); vcf = star alleles from the VCF only.
#   A bam row must be a gene pypgx's own gene table marks SV=TRUE (it has a CNV model in the
#   pypgx-bundle): pypgx/api/data/gene-table.csv at the pinned tag (PYPGX_BUNDLE_VERSION in
#   versions.env). In 0.26.0 those are the 13 bam rows below; tests/test_pypgx_genes.sh fails
#   when a bam row is not one of them, or when one of them is not a bam row.
# callable_without_alt: no = the gene lies on an ALT contig in GRCh38, so a BAM aligned to the
#   default no-ALT reference cannot hold it. The step checks the BAM for alt_contig; without it
#   the gene is left out of depth preparation (which would fail for every bam gene) and its
#   summary row says "not callable on this reference".
# alt_contig: the contig a callable_without_alt=no gene needs; . otherwise.
# second_caller: the other tool in this pipeline that calls the gene; none otherwise.
# pharmcat_outside_call: yes = step 36 (bin/pgx_outside_calls.py) can pass this gene's call to
#   PharmCAT as an outside call (CYP2D6, only when pypgx and Cyrius agree); no otherwise.
